item.title: Europe's hot stock markets are creating a buzz among investors
item.description: The region's resilience has surprised the market, and demand remains stronger than expected.

item.title: 'Millennials are not punk kids anymore' — Ocasio-Cortez sees a 'generational tidal wave' driven by anger over economic futures sidelined by boomers
item.description: There is anger at being ignored and having economic futures mortgaged by previous generations on issues like the environment and debt.

item.title: Netanyahu rejects Hamas disarmament proposal touted by Trump
item.description: The IDF will not withdraw until Hamas is genuinely disarmed, and it will continue to thwart threats against Israeli forces and citizens.
